audience: Desk staff processing many equipment loans every day; accuracy and fast scanning matter.
request: Build a polished working app for checking equipment loans and preparing returns. The existing approved brand uses system sans, navy #14263d, blue #2255cc, cool off-white #f3f5f8. Keep this identity and the useful information density. Focus on the actual desk workflow.
required_behavior: Search the actual loans by person, item or ID; combine this with a status filter and provide a clear reset/empty state.
Open a loan detail, mark it returned locally, and update relevant row state and counts. Allow undo of the latest return.
Loan ID, person, equipment, due time and state must remain discoverable on narrow screens.
constraints: Fictional offline demo, not a live lending system. Clearly label local return behavior.
Preserve provided brand and every loan fact. No invented aggregate metrics.
Use system fonts; no dependencies or external network requests.
